L7: # Tax return
L8: 
L9: If you reside in the Faroe Islands and have an income and/or deduction from the Faroes or abroad, you are liable to pay tax and possibly also submit a tax return.
L10: 
L11: There are three different groups of taxpayers in the Faroes: ordinary taxpayers, self-employed and companies.
L12: 
L13: Ordinary taxpayers
L14: Most people fall into this category. These are individuals who receive salary/wages from their employer, paid via the automatic tax-withholding system. TAKS usually has the necessary information about these individuals, such as earned income, deductions and number of children.
L15: If you are an ordinary taxpayer, you are usually not required to submit a tax return, because the correct information has already been recorded in the preliminary tax assessment register. Instead, you will receive a pre-completed tax statement, which contains an overview of your income and deductions. If the statement is correct, you are not required to do anything, but if the statement is incorrect, you must complete and submit a tax return containing the correct information.
L16: 
L17: Self-employed
L18: If you work for yourself rather than an employer, you are self-employed. This could be, for example, a sole proprietorship, a partnership, a jointly owned shipping firm, the estate of a deceased person, a landlord or a private limited company. What these have in common, are that they have a B-income, which is income from their own business that is not taxed at source, and that they have a duty to keep accounts.
L19: Another thing they have in common is that their taxes are linked to their p-tal, meaning that the private individual behind the business is directly taxed on the profit.
L20: Taxpayers in this category always receive a tax return, which they are required to submit along with their accounts and property statement.
L21: 
L22: Companies etc.
L23: This category includes limited companies (P/F), private limited companies (Sp/F), investment funds, organisations, interest groups and estates of deceased persons. These are always registered with a V-tal (Faroese VAT number) and will always receive a tax return, which they are required to submit along with their accounts. Companies that have been granted a tax exemption are also required to submit a tax return along with their accounts.
L24: 
L25: How and when to submit your tax return
L26: There are two ways to submit your tax return: online on Borgaragluggin or by post.
L27: 
L28: Online on Borgaragluggin
L29: This is the simplest way to submit your tax return. The forms are ready to be completed digitally and can be submitted directly on Borgaragluggin.
L30: 
L31: By post
L32: If you prefer to submit the tax return by post, you can print out the form, complete it and send it to TAKS, Postboks 2151, 110 Tórshavn. Find the tax return form under Forms.
L33: But please note, that if you are liable to submit your accounts, this must be done on Borgaragluggin.
L34: 
L35: The deadline for submission is 1 May
L36: Ordinary taxpayers and self-employed are required to submit their tax return by 1 May.
L37: If you have not submitted your completed tax return by this date, TAKS is authorised to impose a fine of minimum DKK 1,000. If you still do not submit the tax return, TAKS will make a tax estimation and send a notice of hearing where you may bring forward comments on TAKS' estimation. This is usually done in September. If we do not hear from you, the tax will be appointed according to the notice of hearing. This will be carried out before 1 October.
L38: Limited companies etc. are required to submit their tax return by 1 July.
L39: 
L40: Request a deadline extension
L41: You may request a deadline extension, if you have a valid reason, such as illness etc. Send the written application by post to TAKS, Postboks 2151, 110 Tórshavn. The deadline cannot be extended beyond 15 August.
L42: 
L43: Please note:
L44:   * Individuals: each application can only be for one person. All previous tax returns, capital gains tax returns, accounts and property statements must have been submitted before 30 April.
L45:   * Companies: each application can only be for one company. All previous tax returns and accounts must have been submitted before 30 June.
L46: 
L47: Submitting accounts
L48: 
L49: If you are self-employed, you are liable to keep accounts.
L50: Self-employed have a duty to submit their accounts with the tax return. The accounts must be entered into TAKS' accounting template, which exists in six variations - find the templates under Forms. The accounts must be submitted with the tax return on Borgaragluggin in excel format. The accounts cannot be submitted in any other way.
L51: 
L52: Property statement
L53: A property statement, in Faroese ognaruppgerð, is an outline of your possessions and debts. If you own property or are liable to keep accounts, and have full tax liability in the Faroes, you must enclose a property statement with your tax return.
L54: If you have a duty to keep accounts, you will receive the property statement from TAKS, which you must enclose with your tax return. If you are not obliged to keep accounts, but own property or financial rights, you should only submit a property statement if there have been any changes to your property or rights compared to the previous year. In this case, you can get the property statement from TAKS' customer service, tel. 35 26 00.
L55: 
L56: The property statement should include:
L57:   * real property
L58:   * cars, boats, furniture and other movable property
L59:   * goods, commodities and machinery
L60:   * money, outstanding debt and shares in companies
L61:   * art, stamp collections and ornaments that are worth over DKK 25.000
L62: 
L63: The property statement should not include:
L64:   * inheritance or presents where it is stipulated that another individual is the initial recipient of the income and that the holder does not control the property in the meantime
L65:   * inheritance or presents where it is stipulated that the income should at first be kept and that the holder does not control the property or income in the meantime
L66:   * tenure for limited-time payments or gains, such as pension rights, life annuity, rent-free residence etc.
L67: Property belonging to children under the age of 16 is included in the property statement of the parent who has custody.
L68: 
L69: Want to change the account number for the tax refund?
L70: 
L71: If you are due a tax refund from the previous tax year, you will usually receive it in March. If you want to change the bank account for the refund, you must do it well in advance.
L72: The easiest way to notify TAKS of a change of bank account is to use TAKS' online portal, Borgaragluggin, where you can change the bank account under Basic information > Contact information.
L73: 
L74: Need help with the tax return?
L75: 
L76: Feel free to call our customer service on tel. 35 26 00 Monday to Thursday from 10 am to 12 pm or send an e-mail to taks@taks.fo. We are happy to help.

L7: # Land fyri land-frágreiðing
L8: 
L9: Sambært lóg skulu ávís fleirtjóða samtaksfeløg í Føroyum árliga lata TAKS eina land fyri land-frágreiðing, har tey til skattaeftirlits greina búskaparliga virksemi sítt farna roknskaparárið. Háttlíka gera samtaksfeløg aðrastaðni fyri sínum skattamyndugleikum.
L10: 
L11: Á enskum eitur frágreiðingin Country-by-Country Report, stytt CbC Report. Tað er útfyllingarleistur, ásettur OECD.
L12: 
L13: Hvørji samtaksfeløg skulu lata TAKS land fyri land-frágreiðing?
L14: Tað skulu samtaksfeløg (feløg og fastir rakstrarstaðir), sum eru ultimativ móðurfeløg ella umboðsmóðurfeløg í fleirtjóða samtøkum, og sum hava ein samlaðan umsetning fyri alt samtakið á minst 5,6 milliardir krónur í eitt roknskaparár.
L15: 
L16: Markið á 5,6 milliardir krónur skal tulkast sambært vegleiðing hjá OECD um gjaldoyrasveiggj. Sí bls. 21 í "Vegleiðing um íverkseting av land fyri land-frágreiðing" undir leinkjum her á síðuni.
L17: Hevur fleirtjóða samtak fleiri innlatingarskyldig samtaksfeløg í Føroyum, skulu hesi sambært § 118 d, stk. 2, 1. pkt. í skattalógini sínámillum gera av, hvat teirra skal lata inn frágreiðingina. Les meira hesi viðurskifti niðari á síðuni í partinum Fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu.
L18: 
L19: TAKS skal hava avrit av fulltrú, um triðipersónur letur inn vegna samtaksfelagið.
L20: ## Undantaksreglan
L21: 
L22: Hóast samtaksfelag sambært nevndu reglum eigur at lata inn land fyri land-frágreiðing til TAKS, so skal kortini ikki latast inn, um fleirtjóða samtakið samstundis letur inn land fyri land-frágreiðing fyri sama roknskaparár í rættardømi, sum hevur avtalu við Føroyar um útveksling av land fyri land-frágreiðingum.
L23: Tílík útvekslingsavtala kom í gildi í mai 2023, og TAKS hevur hana við fleiri lond. Síggj tey við undir leinkjum við at klikkja á “Heimasíðan hjá OECD: Virkjaðar avtalur um útveksling av land-fyri-land-frágreiðing.” Tá tú ert komin inn á síðuna, skriva Faroe Islands í leitigluggan. Tá koma londini fram.
L24: 
L25: Sjálva útvekslingsavtaluna sært tú undir leinkinum: Fleirtjóða avtala um útveksling av land fyri land-frágreiðingum.
L26: ## Samtaksfelagið skal tó altíð lata TAKS fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu
L27: 
L28: Annars er undantaksreglan ikki galdandi. Les meira um hesa fráboðan niðari í partinum Fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu.
L29: 
L30: Hvat skal við í frágreiðingina?
L31: Frágreiðingin skal upplýsa um alt búskaparligt virksemi hjá øllum samtakinum í øllum londum. Til dømis í hvørjum skattligum rættardømum, samtakið hevur virksemi, hvat umsetningurin og vinningurin hava verið, hvat rindað er í skatti, hvussu stór ognin er, hvussu nógv starvsfólk eru, hvat slag av virksemi, samtakið rekur, og hvørjar eindir eru partur av samtakinum.
L32: 
L33: Alt skal við.
L34: 
L35: Fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu
L36: Sama hvat samtaksfelag letur inn land fyri land-frágreiðingina, er tann regla galdandi, at føroysk samtaksfeløg sambært § 118 f, stk. 1, í skattalógini skulu geva TAKS fráboðan um, hvat felag hevur skyldu at lata inn land fyri land-frágreiðing, og í hvørjum rættardømi, tað verður gjørt.
L37: 
L38: Fráboðanin verður gjørd við at fylla út oyðublaðið Fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu. Heinta tað undir oyðubløðum her á síðuni.
L39: 
L40: Freistir og adressur
L41: ## Land fyri land-frágreiðing
L42: 
L43: Skal sambært § 118 c, stk. 2, í skattalógini latast inn í seinasta lagi 12 mánaðir eftir síðsta dag í tí inntøkuári, sum frágreiðingin er fyri. Send um álítandi postskipan til taks@taks.fo ella lat okkum hana á annan tryggan hátt. Viðmerk: Land fyri land-frágreiðing.
L44: ## Fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu
L45: 
L46: Skal sambært § 118 f, stk. 1, latast inn í seinasta lagi áðrenn árslok tað inntøkuárið, sum land fyri land-frágreiðingin fevnir um. Send við teldubrævi til taks@taks.fo (taks@taks.foe) ella við vanligum brævi til TAKS, Postboks 2151, 110 Tórshavn.
L47: 
L48: Heinta alt tilfar her á síðuni
L49: 
L50: Tað liggur klárt undir leinkjum. Útfyllingarleistur til land fyri land-frágreiðing, fráboðan um innlatingarskyldu, útfyllingarvegleiðingar og útvekslingsavtala.
L51: Vegleiðingar og útvekslingsavtala eru á enskum.
